chambers.name: Full-Bore Chamber
chambers.description: The Full-Bore Chamber is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Fires a piercing bolt in a line, dealing damage that falls as it travels.
Empowered: Deals greatly increased damage and pushes the slayer backwards.

chambers.name: Marksman Chamber
chambers.description: The Marksman Chamber is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Fires a shot in a line, dealing {{damage}} damage to the first Behemoth hit. If a part is struck, that part takes {{percentDamage}}% more damage from Shots for {{damageTime}} seconds.
Empowered: Damage bonus increased to {{empoweredPercentDamage}}%, and {{empoweredPercentAllyDamage}}% to all allies.

chambers.name: Salvo Chamber
chambers.description: The Salvo Chamber is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Fires an explosive missile in a line, dealing {{damage}} damage in an area upon impact.
Empowered: Fires {{missiles}} missiles in a spread.

grips.name: Captain's Grip
grips.description: The Captain's Grip is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Launches a collectible buff a short distance, granting {{percentAttackSpeed}}% increased attack speed for {{attackSpeedTime}} seconds when collected.
Empowered: Grants the same buff to all Slayers.

grips.name: Saboteur's Grip
grips.description: The Saboteur's Grip is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Launches an explosive mine that deals {{damage}} damage. Mine charges after a short period, increasing damage to {{increasedDamage}}.
Empowered: Deals {{empoweredDamage}} damage when charged and can interrupt Behemoths.

mods.name: Capacitive Magazine
partEffect: Using an ability returns {{ammo}} standard ammo to the magazine.

mods.name: Demolition Sights
partEffect: While empowered, deal +{{percentObjectDamage}}% damage to objects created by Behemoths.

mods.name: Extraction Catalyst
partEffect: Reduce both ability cooldowns by {{cooldownReduction}} seconds when dodging through Behemoth attacks.

mods.name: Lightweight Frame
partEffect: Gain {{percentMovespeed}}% increased movespeed when at {{currentAmmo}} or less ammo.

mods.name: Lucky Magazine
partEffect: Grants {{percentCritChance}}% critical strike chance for each round missing from the magazine.

mods.name: Precision Sights
partEffect: Deal {{damage}} increased damage when attacking the same part multiple times. Stacks up to {{stacks}} times.

mods.name: Tactician's Magazine
partEffect: Empowered Reloading at exactly {{currentAmmo}} ammo decreases the cooldown of both abilities by {{cooldownReduction}} seconds.
